scenario: A loyalty program operations team processes a nightly batch of point-redemption requests exported from the platform event log. The pipeline normalizes the raw CSV export into a fulfillment-ready dataset, audits each account's redemption eligibility against current loyalty program rules (verifying that the requested point value does not exceed the account balance), and then produces a batch release memo authorizing the approved redemptions for fulfillment.
info_flow: ub2-csv-data-analyzer loads and normalizes the raw redemption batch CSV, producing a cleaned fulfillment dataset → presale-regulation-auditor audits each row against the loyalty program eligibility rules (balance vs. redemption amount) and produces an eligibility status per account → reporting assembles the audit findings into a batch release memo listing approved and denied redemptions.
